text: 害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无
pinyin: hài rén zhī xīn bù kě yǒu, fáng rén zhī xīn bù kě wú
literal: harm · people · 's · heart · must not · have, guard against · people · 's · heart · must not · lack
natural: never harm others, but never drop your guard

meaning.en: Never intend harm to others, but always stay on guard against those who might harm you.
meaning.zh: 不能有害别人的念头，但必须对别人可能的伤害有所防备。

equivalents: trust, but verify
be kind, but keep your eyes open

examples.zh: 俗话说，害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无，签合同前一定要看清条款。
examples.en: As the saying goes, never mean harm but never lower your guard; read the terms before signing.

examples.zh: 妈妈常教育我：害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无。
examples.en: Mum always taught me: never mean harm to anyone, but never be naive either.

usage.en: Advice quoted as a proverb, usually warning someone who is too trusting.
usage.zh: 多作劝诫的话，提醒过于轻信的人。

pinyin: jūn zǐ dòng kǒu bù dòng shǒu
literal: gentleman · move · mouth · not · move · hand
natural: a gentleman argues, he doesn't fight

meaning.en: A civilised person settles disputes by talking, not with his fists.
meaning.zh: 有教养的人用言语讲理，不用拳脚解决问题。

equivalents: use your words, not your fists
talk it out, don't fight

examples.zh: 君子动口不动手，有话好好说，别打人。
examples.en: A gentleman uses words, not fists; talk it through and don't hit anyone.

examples.zh: 两人吵得面红耳赤，同事劝道：君子动口不动手。
examples.en: The two were arguing hotly; a colleague stepped in: no fighting, just talk.

usage.en: Often said to stop a quarrel; also used jokingly when someone lashes out.
usage.zh: 常用来劝架，也可开玩笑地说。

pinyin: jūn zǐ ài cái, qǔ zhī yǒu dào
literal: gentleman · love · wealth, take · it · have · proper way
natural: a gentleman loves money but earns it honestly

meaning.en: Wanting wealth is fine, as long as it is gained by honest and proper means.
meaning.zh: 喜欢钱财没有错，但要通过正当的途径获得。

equivalents: make money honestly
an honest buck

examples.zh: 君子爱财，取之有道，这笔钱不该拿的坚决不能拿。
examples.en: A gentleman loves money but earns it honestly; money like this must not be taken.

examples.zh: 老板常说君子爱财，取之有道，所以公司从不偷税漏税。
examples.en: The boss always says wealth must be earned properly, so the firm never evades tax.

usage.en: Frequently quoted in business and ethics talk; sometimes said ironically by people excusing a profit.
usage.zh: 常用于谈做生意的道德，有时也被反讽。

pinyin: xiǎo bù rěn zé luàn dà móu
literal: small · not · endure · then · upset · big · plan
natural: lose your patience over small things and you ruin the big plan

meaning.en: Failing to put up with small annoyances can wreck a major plan.
meaning.zh: 小事上不能忍耐，就会破坏大的计划。

equivalents: patience is a virtue
bear a little to win much

examples.zh: 小不忍则乱大谋，现在先别跟他翻脸。
examples.en: Petty impatience ruins great plans; don't fall out with him yet.

examples.zh: 创业初期要记住小不忍则乱大谋，客户再刁难也得耐心。
examples.en: Early in a start-up, remember that a little patience protects the big plan, however awkward the client.

story.en: Confucius says that clever talk confuses virtue, and that failing to endure small matters upsets great plans.
story.zh: 《论语·卫灵公》：“巧言乱德。小不忍，则乱大谋。”

usage.en: Advises restraint; often quoted to oneself or to a hot-headed friend.
usage.zh: 劝人克制忍耐，多用于自勉或劝人。

pinyin: shū dào yòng shí fāng hèn shǎo
literal: books · when · use · time · only then · regret · few
natural: only when you need a book do you regret reading so few

meaning.en: You only realise how little you have read when you need the knowledge.
meaning.zh: 到需要运用知识的时候，才后悔平时读书太少。

equivalents: you don't know what you've got until you need it
study now or regret it later

examples.zh: 书到用时方恨少，平时多读点书总没错。
examples.en: One regrets having read too little only when the need arises; it never hurts to read more.

examples.zh: 写论文时我才体会到书到用时方恨少。
examples.en: Writing my thesis, I finally felt how little I had read.

usage.en: A standard nudge to students; the next line is often 事非经过不知难.
usage.zh: 常用来劝学生多读书，下句常接“事非经过不知难”。

text: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲
pinyin: shào zhuàng bù nǔ lì, lǎo dà tú shāng bēi
literal: young and strong · not · work hard, old · in vain · grieve
natural: if you slack off in youth, you will only grieve in old age

meaning.en: Those who do not work hard while young will regret it bitterly when old.
meaning.zh: 年轻力壮时不努力，到老只能白白伤心后悔。

equivalents: a lazy youth makes a sorry old age
make hay while the sun shines

examples.zh: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲，趁年轻多学点本事吧。
examples.en: Idle youth means sorrowful old age; learn some skills while you are young.

examples.zh: 爷爷总用“少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲”教育我们。
examples.en: Grandpa always lectured us with 'work hard when young or grieve when old'.

story.en: The Han Yuefu poem 'Chang Ge Xing' compares youth to morning dew and ends by urging people to work hard before their hair turns white.
story.zh: 《长歌行》：“百川东到海，何时复西归？少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。”

date.en: Han dynasty, 2nd c. BC–1st c. AD

usage.en: Quoted as a poem line to urge diligence; formal tone when written.
usage.zh: 多作为诗句引用，劝人珍惜时光、努力上进。

synonyms: 花有重开日，人无再少年
莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切

text: 台上一分钟，台下十年功
pinyin: tái shàng yī fēn zhōng, tái xià shí nián gōng
literal: stage · on · one · minute, stage · off · ten · year · effort
natural: a minute on stage takes ten years of work off it

meaning.en: A brief, polished performance is the product of long years of unseen practice.
meaning.zh: 舞台上短短一分钟的精彩，是台下多年苦练换来的。

equivalents: Rome wasn't built in a day
behind every great performance lies years of practice

examples.zh: 台上一分钟，台下十年功，演员们每天练到深夜。
examples.en: A minute on stage costs ten years of practice; the actors rehearse every night till late.

examples.zh: 别看她只跳了三分钟，台上一分钟，台下十年功啊。
examples.en: She only danced for three minutes, but a minute on stage takes ten years off it.

usage.en: Originally from the opera world; now applied to any skill with unseen preparation.
usage.zh: 原指戏曲行业，现可泛指任何需要长期积累的技艺。

text: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针
pinyin: zhǐ yào gōng fū shēn, tiě chǔ mó chéng zhēn
literal: as long as · effort · deep, iron · pestle · grind · into · needle
natural: with enough effort, an iron rod can be ground into a needle

meaning.en: With enough perseverance, even the hardest task can be accomplished.
meaning.zh: 只要肯下苦功夫，再难的事也能做成。

equivalents: slow and steady wins the race
where there's a will there's a way

examples.zh: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针，你每天坚持练习就会进步。
examples.en: With enough effort even an iron rod becomes a needle; keep practising daily and you will improve.

examples.zh: 别灰心，只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针。
examples.en: Don't lose heart: perseverance can grind iron into a needle.

usage.en: Encouragement to persevere; also seen as 铁杵磨成针 alone.
usage.zh: 用来鼓励人坚持，也常单说“铁杵磨成针”。

pinyin: jī bù kě shī, shí bù zài lái
literal: opportunity · must not · lose, time · not · again · come
natural: don't miss the chance, it won't come again

meaning.en: An opportunity must be seized, because it will not come around again.
meaning.zh: 机会难得，错过了就不会再有。

equivalents: seize the day
opportunity knocks but once

examples.zh: 机不可失，时不再来，这个项目我们必须马上拿下。
examples.en: Opportunity must be seized, for it will not return; we must land this project now.

examples.zh: 打折只有今天，机不可失，时不再来！
examples.en: The sale ends today; don't miss out, it won't come again!

usage.en: Used to urge quick action, also in advertising.
usage.zh: 多用于催促人抓紧行动，也常见于广告。

synonyms: 过了这个村就没这个店

text: 良药苦口利于病，忠言逆耳利于行
pinyin: liáng yào kǔ kǒu lì yú bìng, zhōng yán nì ěr lì yú xíng
literal: good · medicine · bitter · mouth · benefit · illness, loyal · words · jar · ear · benefit · conduct
natural: good medicine tastes bitter, honest advice grates on the ear

meaning.en: Good medicine is bitter yet cures illness; honest advice is unwelcome yet improves conduct.
meaning.zh: 好药味苦却能治病，诚恳的劝告虽刺耳却有助于改正行为。

equivalents: a bitter pill to swallow, but good for you
the truth hurts

examples.zh: 良药苦口利于病，忠言逆耳利于行，别嫌我说话直。
examples.en: Good medicine is bitter and honest advice is harsh, so don't mind my bluntness.

examples.zh: 他的批评虽然难听，但良药苦口利于病，忠言逆耳利于行。
examples.en: His criticism was hard to hear, but good medicine is bitter and honest words grate.

story.en: Zhang Liang urged Liu Bang to follow advice, saying that loyal words grate on the ear but help conduct, and bitter medicine helps illness. The Kongzi Jiayu later has a version attributed to Confucius.
story.zh: 张良劝刘邦听从谏言，说“忠言逆耳利于行，毒药苦口利于病”；《孔子家语·六本》后来有托名孔子的近似说法。

usage.en: Used to soften or accept frank criticism; the halves are often quoted separately.
usage.zh: 用来表示接受或缓和直率的批评，上下句常分开引用。

pinyin: páng guān zhě qīng, dāng jú zhě mí
literal: onlooker · clear, person in the game · confused
natural: the bystander sees clearly, the player is baffled

meaning.en: Onlookers see a situation clearly while those involved are confused by it.
meaning.zh: 局外人看得清楚，当事人反而糊涂。

equivalents: the onlooker sees most of the game
you can't see the wood for the trees

examples.zh: 旁观者清，当局者迷，你问问朋友怎么看。
examples.en: Onlookers see clearly while those involved are confused; ask your friends what they think.

examples.zh: 他在感情里钻牛角尖，旁观者清，当局者迷。
examples.en: He is stuck in his relationship; outsiders see it plainly, but he cannot.

usage.en: Often said when advising someone to seek an outside view.
usage.zh: 常在建议别人听取局外人意见时使用。

story.en: In Yuan Xingchong's biography, a preface says that one in the game is confused while the onlooker sees clearly. The popular form 旁观者清，当局者迷 is built from this.
story.zh: 《旧唐书·元行冲传》载其文“当局称迷，傍观见审”；今通行的“旁观者清，当局者迷”由此演变。

text: 一个篱笆三个桩，一个好汉三个帮
pinyin: yī gè lí ba sān gè zhuāng, yī gè hǎo hàn sān gè bāng
literal: one · fence · three · posts, one · hero · three · helpers
natural: a fence needs three posts, a hero needs three helpers

meaning.en: Even a capable person needs the help of others to succeed.
meaning.zh: 再能干的人也需要别人的帮助才能成事。

equivalents: no man is an island
many hands make light work

examples.zh: 一个篱笆三个桩，一个好汉三个帮，你别逞强。
examples.en: A fence needs three posts and a hero three helpers; don't try to do it all yourself.

examples.zh: 创业不能单打独斗，一个篱笆三个桩，一个好汉三个帮。
examples.en: You can't start a business alone; even a hero needs helpers.

usage.en: Rustic, folksy; encourages teamwork and accepting help.
usage.zh: 带乡土色彩，提倡合作、接受帮助。

synonyms: 三个臭皮匠，顶个诸葛亮

text: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友
pinyin: zài jiā kào fù mǔ, chū mén kào péng you
variants: 在家靠父母，出外靠朋友
literal: at · home · rely on · parents, go out · rely on · friends
natural: at home you rely on parents, away from home on friends

meaning.en: At home you depend on your parents; out in the world you depend on friends.
meaning.zh: 在家里依靠父母，在外面要靠朋友帮忙。

equivalents: a friend in need is a friend indeed

examples.zh: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友，多交几个可靠的朋友。
examples.en: At home it's parents, outside it's friends; make a few reliable ones.

examples.zh: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友，他在外地多亏同乡照顾。
examples.en: He leaned on friends away from home, and his fellow townsmen looked after him.

usage.en: Said to stress the value of friendship, especially when travelling or working away.
usage.zh: 强调朋友的重要，尤其是在外地时。

pinyin: duō yī gè péng you duō yī tiáo lù
literal: more · one · friend · more · one · road
natural: one more friend, one more road

meaning.en: The more friends you have, the more options and opportunities open up.
meaning.zh: 朋友多了，办事的门路就多。

equivalents: the more friends, the more doors open

examples.zh: 多一个朋友多一条路，有空多出来聚聚。
examples.en: Each friend opens another road; come out and meet up more often.

examples.zh: 他人缘好，多一个朋友多一条路，到哪儿都有人帮忙。
examples.en: He's well liked; every friend is another road, so he finds help everywhere.

usage.en: Common in networking and social talk, often paired with 少一个敌人少一堵墙.
usage.zh: 常用于交际场合，常和“少一个敌人少一堵墙”并说。

synonyms: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友

pinyin: huàn nàn jiàn zhēn qíng
literal: hardship · reveals · true · feeling
natural: hardship reveals true feeling

meaning.en: True friendship and loyalty show themselves in times of trouble.
meaning.zh: 只有在困难危急的时候，才能看出真正的感情。

equivalents: a friend in need is a friend indeed

examples.zh: 患难见真情，这次多亏你们帮我渡过难关。
examples.en: Hardship reveals true feeling; thanks to you all for getting me through.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩一起扛过破产，真是患难见真情。
examples.en: The couple weathered bankruptcy together; trouble truly reveals love.

usage.en: Often as a commentary after a crisis; a longer form is 患难见真情，烈火炼真金.
usage.zh: 常用于危难之后的感慨。

synonyms: 路遥知马力，日久见人心
antonyms: 穷在闹市无人问，富在深山有远亲

pinyin: wù yǐ lèi jù, rén yǐ qún fēn
literal: things · by · kind · gather, people · by · group · divide
natural: things gather by kind, people divide by group

meaning.en: Like attracts like: people with similar tastes and character tend to end up together.
meaning.zh: 同类的东西聚在一起，志趣相投的人结成群体。

equivalents: birds of a feather flock together

examples.zh: 物以类聚，人以群分，他的朋友个个爱赛车。
examples.en: Birds of a feather flock together; all his friends love racing.

examples.zh: 别怪她，物以类聚，人以群分，她身边就是这样的人。
examples.en: Don't blame her; like attracts like, and that's the crowd she keeps.

usage.en: Neutral, but often used critically about someone's bad company.
usage.zh: 本身中性，但常用来评论别人交往的圈子。

synonyms: 鱼找鱼，虾找虾，乌龟专找王八

story.en: The Commentary on the Appended Phrases of the Book of Changes says 'Kinds gather by type, things divide by group'. The idiom is a later recasting of this line, meaning that like-minded people and like things come together.
story.zh: 《周易·系辞上》云：“方以类聚，物以群分，吉凶生矣。”后演变为“物以类聚，人以群分”，指同类的事物或志趣相投的人会聚在一起。

text: 龙生龙，凤生凤，老鼠的儿子会打洞
pinyin: lóng shēng lóng, fèng shēng fèng, lǎo shǔ de ér zi huì dǎ dòng
variants: 龙配龙，凤配凤，老鼠的孩子会打洞
literal: dragon · bears · dragon, phoenix · bears · phoenix, mouse · 's · son · can · dig · hole
natural: dragons beget dragons, phoenixes phoenixes, a mouse's son digs holes

meaning.en: Children tend to inherit their parents' nature, for better or worse.
meaning.zh: 子女会继承父母的特点，好的坏的都一样。

equivalents: like father, like son
the apple doesn't fall far from the tree

examples.zh: 龙生龙，凤生凤，老鼠的儿子会打洞，他爸是工程师，他也爱搭模型。
examples.en: Like father, like son: his dad is an engineer and he loves building models.

examples.zh: 人们常说龙生龙，凤生凤，老鼠的儿子会打洞，可后天教育同样重要。
examples.en: They say dragons beget dragons and mice beget burrowers, but upbringing matters just as much.

usage.en: Folksy, sometimes used to stereotype (the full form is considered crude about class); the short form 龙生龙，凤生凤 is milder.
usage.zh: 口语色彩，完整说法带有出身偏见；简说“龙生龙，凤生凤”较温和。

pinyin: yī fāng shuǐ tǔ yǎng yī fāng rén
literal: one · region · water and soil · raise · one · region · people
natural: each place's land raises its own kind of people

meaning.en: The environment of a region shapes the character and habits of its people.
meaning.zh: 各地的自然环境和风土，造就了当地人不同的性格与习惯。

equivalents: every region breeds its own people

examples.zh: 一方水土养一方人，南方人和北方人口味就是不一样。
examples.en: Each region raises its own people; southerners and northerners simply taste differently.

examples.zh: 一方水土养一方人，这里的姑娘个个能歌善舞。
examples.en: The land shapes its people; the girls here can all sing and dance.

usage.en: Used when explaining regional differences in character, food and customs.
usage.zh: 常用来解释地域在性格、饮食、习俗上的差异。

pinyin: dào shén me shān shàng chàng shén me gē
literal: reach · what · mountain · on · sing · what · song
natural: sing the song that fits the mountain you're on

meaning.en: Adapt your words and behaviour to the place and circumstances you are in.
meaning.zh: 到了什么地方，就按那里的情况说话做事。

equivalents: when in Rome, do as the Romans do

examples.zh: 到什么山上唱什么歌，出国了就得适应当地习惯。
examples.en: Sing the song of whatever mountain you're on; abroad you must adapt to local ways.

examples.zh: 他很会到什么山上唱什么歌，跟谁都聊得来。
examples.en: He knows how to fit in wherever he goes and gets along with everyone.

usage.en: Can be neutral advice or, applied to a person, a hint of opportunism.
usage.zh: 可作中性劝告，用于人身上有时略带见风使舵之意。

pinyin: jiā jiā yǒu běn nán niàn de jīng
literal: every · family · has · volume · hard · to recite · 's · scripture
natural: every family has a scripture that is hard to recite

meaning.en: Every household has its own troubles that outsiders do not see.
meaning.zh: 每个家庭都有自己难处理的烦心事。

equivalents: every family has its skeleton in the cupboard
everyone has their own troubles

examples.zh: 别羡慕他，家家有本难念的经。
examples.en: Don't envy him; every family has its own troubles.

examples.zh: 家家有本难念的经，外人只看到风光的一面。
examples.en: Every household has its burdens; outsiders only see the glamorous side.

usage.en: Consoling or explaining that nobody's life is as easy as it looks.
usage.zh: 用于安慰人，或说明谁家都有难处。

pinyin: jiā hé wàn shì xīng
literal: family · harmony · ten thousand · things · prosper
natural: with harmony at home, everything prospers

meaning.en: When the family lives in harmony, everything else goes well.
meaning.zh: 家庭和睦，各种事情都会顺利。

equivalents: a happy home is the foundation of success

examples.zh: 家和万事兴，一家人别为小事吵架。
examples.en: Harmony at home brings prosperity; don't quarrel over trifles.

examples.zh: 春节对联上常写着“家和万事兴”。
examples.en: 'Harmony at home, prosperity in all' is often written on Spring Festival couplets.

usage.en: Common on couplets and in wishes; also used to settle family disputes.
usage.zh: 常见于春联和祝福语，也用于劝和。

pinyin: jiā yǒu yī lǎo, rú yǒu yī bǎo
literal: home · have · one · elder, like · have · one · treasure
natural: an elder in the house is like a treasure

meaning.en: An older person in the family is a treasure, thanks to their experience and wisdom.
meaning.zh: 家里有位老人，就像有一件宝贝，因为他们见多识广、经验丰富。

equivalents: old heads on young shoulders are a treasure

examples.zh: 家有一老，如有一宝，奶奶总能解决我们的难题。
examples.en: An elder at home is a treasure; Grandma always solves our problems.

examples.zh: 他很尊敬邻居老人，常说家有一老，如有一宝。
examples.en: He respects the old folk next door, saying an elder is a treasure.

usage.en: Warm and respectful; often combined with 不听老人言，吃亏在眼前.
usage.zh: 语气尊敬温暖，常和“不听老人言，吃亏在眼前”相连。

pinyin: yǎng ér fáng lǎo, jī gǔ fáng jī
literal: raise · son · prepare against · old age, store · grain · prepare against · hunger
natural: raise sons for old age, store grain against famine

meaning.en: Raise children to look after you in old age, just as you store grain against hunger.
meaning.zh: 养育子女是为了年老时有人照顾，就像储存粮食是为了防备饥荒。

equivalents: save for a rainy day

examples.zh: 养儿防老，积谷防饥，老一辈人很看重子女孝顺。
examples.en: Raise sons for old age and store grain for famine; the older generation values filial children.

examples.zh: 现在有养老金，养儿防老，积谷防饥的观念淡多了。
examples.en: With pensions now, the idea of raising children for old age has faded.

usage.en: Traditional view, now often quoted when discussing pensions and elder care.
usage.zh: 传统观念，现多在谈养老问题时被引用。

pinyin: bù dāng jiā bù zhī chái mǐ guì
literal: not · run · household · not · know · firewood · rice · dear
natural: you don't know what firewood and rice cost until you run the household

meaning.en: Only when you manage the household yourself do you learn how costly daily needs are.
meaning.zh: 不亲自主持家务，就不知道日常开销的艰难。

equivalents: you never know till you have to pay the bills

examples.zh: 不当家不知柴米贵，等你自己租房过日子就明白了。
examples.en: You don't know what things cost till you run a home; you'll see when you rent your own place.

examples.zh: 不当家不知柴米贵，妈妈每个月都精打细算。
examples.en: Mum counts every penny, since you don't know prices until you manage the home.

usage.en: Said to someone naive about money or responsibility; often paired with 不养儿不知父母恩.
usage.zh: 常对不知生活艰难的人说，常与“不养儿不知父母恩”相连。

pinyin: bù yǎng ér bù zhī fù mǔ ēn
literal: not · raise · child · not · know · parents · kindness
natural: you don't appreciate your parents until you raise children

meaning.en: Only when you have raised children yourself do you realise what your parents did for you.
meaning.zh: 自己养育了孩子，才明白父母的恩情有多深。

equivalents: you don't know what your parents did until you have kids

examples.zh: 不养儿不知父母恩，我当了爸爸才懂我爸。
examples.en: You don't know your parents' kindness until you raise a child; becoming a father, I finally understood mine.

examples.zh: 她生了孩子后常感叹不养儿不知父母恩。
examples.en: After having a baby she often sighed that you only appreciate your parents once you have a child.

usage.en: Heartfelt reflection, usually by a new parent.
usage.zh: 多为新手父母的感慨。
